run_spm_train: run the sentencepiece trainer script with command-line arguments to train a language model tokenizer
run_SentencePieceTrainer_Train: run SentencePieceTrainer.Train with joined sys.argv arguments to train a sentencepiece model
create_sentencepiece_model: create a sentencepiece model by running spm_train.py with input corpus and model prefix arguments
train_sentencepiece_tokenizer: train a sentencepiece tokenizer from a text corpus using the spm_train.py script
review_spm_train: review the spm_train.py script that wraps SentencePieceTrainer.Train with command-line arguments
